Zone 3

We open the box, show you the part, then close it clean

Zone 3 won't shut off. Water runs down the gutter at five in the morning. We flag the head, open the valve box, and show you the torn diaphragm. One part, one price, tested before we leave.

  • Flag · mark every head in the zone
  • Open · lift the lid, expose the valve
  • Fix · replace what failed, test each head
  • Close · backfill, sod laid back, nothing left behind

Every service, priced per fix

  • Sprinkler repair

    Broken heads, stuck zones and soggy spots found and fixed, one zone at a time.

    Price it

  • Valve repair and replacement

    Zone that won't shut off or won't start: we open the box and replace what failed.

    Price it

  • Drip conversion

    Spray zones in the beds swapped for drip lines that water the roots, not the stucco.

    Price it

    Trenched, piped and zoned for your yard's sun, shade and clay, then tested head by head.

    Price it

  • Smart controller setup

    A weather-aware controller installed and set for valley heat, so the schedule changes with the weather.

    Price it

  • Leak detection

    A high water bill or a wet patch traced to the exact pipe or fitting.

    Price it

  • Backflow testing
